records.source: Oh! I thought you knew.#$b#This room's for developing photos.
records.translation: 喔！我以為你知道。#$b#這個房間是用來沖洗照片的。

records.source: Is that so...?$s
records.translation: 是這樣嗎……？$s

records.source: No, you won't! This bracelet was passed down to me by my great-grandmother!$a
records.translation: 不，你不會！這只手鐲是曾祖母傳給我的！$a

records.source: *sigh*$s#$b#...Maybe it'll wash up on another shore. I can't bear to think of it at the bottom of the ocean.$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*$s#$b#……也許它會被沖上另一處海岸。我受不了想到它沉在海底。$s

records.source: Him? No!#$b#...Well, I guess I used to like Alex. But not anymore! He's immature.
records.translation: 他？才沒有！#$b#……嗯，我想以前確實喜歡過亞歷克斯。但現在不喜歡了！他太幼稚。

records.source: What? That sounds fun, but I wouldn't want to leave Stardew Valley right now...
records.translation: 什麼？聽起來很好玩，但我現在不想離開星露谷……

records.source: Huh? What's an android?
records.translation: 蛤？仿生人是什麼？

records.source: I'm going to get such a nice tan this summer.
records.translation: 今年夏天，我一定會曬出非常好看的膚色。

records.source: Ew, you're all dirty.
records.translation: 噁，你全身都髒兮兮的。

records.source: Um... Yes?#$e#I didn't hear you, I'm thinking about something else.
records.translation: 嗯……怎麼了？#$e#我沒聽見，剛才在想別的事。

records.source: Do you have baby bunnies on your farm? Bunnies are SO cute! <
records.translation: 你的農場有兔寶寶嗎？兔子超級可愛！<

records.source: If you stay in the sun a lot it'll make your hair lighter.#$e#It's a good thing to know!
records.translation: 經常曬太陽會讓髮色變淺。#$e#知道這點很有用！

records.source: I wonder what Alex is doing today...#$e#Huh? I didn't notice you standing there.
records.translation: 不知道亞歷克斯今天在做什麼……#$e#蛤？我沒注意到你站在那裡。

records.source: Farming sounds so boring...#$q 42/43 summer_Sat_old#What do you even do all day?#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#Care for plants#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#Explore the caves#$r 43 -10 summer_Sat_13#Snoop around in your room#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#Dig for treasure
records.translation: 務農聽起來無聊透了……#$q 42/43 summer_Sat_old#你整天到底都在做什麼？#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#照料植物#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#探索洞穴#$r 43 -10 summer_Sat_13#偷看你的房間#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#挖掘寶藏

records.source: #$p 43#Hey, you better not be snooping around in my room anymore!$a|But I guess it could get you in pretty good shape.
records.translation: #$p 43#嘿，你最好別再偷看我的房間！$a|不過我想那能讓你練出很好的身材。

records.source: Hmm... sounds like a lot of work.
records.translation: 嗯……聽起來工作量很大。

records.source: What? You'd better not be doing that!$a
records.translation: 什麼？你最好沒有那樣做！$a

records.source: Emily usually cooks dinner... But she makes weird stuff like quinoa.
records.translation: 晚餐通常是艾蜜莉做……但她會煮藜麥之類的怪東西。

records.source: Do you wear those clothes every day?
records.translation: 你每天都穿那身衣服嗎？

records.source: $p 47#Hey I found this new tool to open jars with. So you won't need to help me anymore.$h|There's not a cloud in the sky today.$h
records.translation: $p 47#嘿，我找到了一種開罐子的新工具。所以再也不需要你幫忙了。$h|今天的天空萬里無雲。$h

records.source: It's so hot today!#$e#I wish I had some ice cream.$s
records.translation: 今天好熱！#$e#真希望有些冰淇淋。$s

records.source: I spent 3 hours practicing my signature today.#$e#I guess that's pretty silly, huh?
records.translation: 我今天花了三個小時練習簽名。#$e#這好像很傻，對吧？

records.source: If you stay in the sun a lot it will make your hair lighter... But you don't want to get sunburnt, either.#$e#I just want a healthy amount of sunlight. Everything in moderation, right?
records.translation: 經常曬太陽會讓髮色變淺……但也不能曬傷。#$e#我只想吸收健康分量的陽光。凡事都要適量，對吧？

records.source: I should start reading some books instead of magazines.#$e#It's good to learn things, isn't it?#$e#I only ever look at the pictures.
records.translation: 我應該開始讀些書，而不是只看雜誌。#$e#學習新事物是好事，對吧？#$e#但我向來只看圖片。

records.source: #$1 HaleySister#I talked to my sister for a while last night. I actually enjoyed it quite a bit.#$e#You know, Emily's not actually that weird. I guess we have more in common than I used to think.#$e#Don't tell her I said so.
records.translation: #$1 HaleySister#昨晚我和姊姊聊了一陣子。其實聊得相當愉快。#$e#你知道嗎，艾蜜莉其實沒那麼奇怪。我想我們的共同點比以前以為的更多。#$e#別告訴她這是我說的。

records.source: It seems like a good day to go swimming.
records.translation: 今天似乎很適合游泳。

records.source: I guess living in the country isn't so bad.#$e#If I lived in the city I might start to miss all the trees.#$e#@, I think I've been hanging out with you too much.$h
records.translation: 看來住在鄉下也沒那麼糟。#$e#如果住在城市裡，也許會開始想念這些樹木。#$e#@，我好像花太多時間和你在一起了。$h

records.source: Oh, hi @!#$e#Do you like kids?$l
records.translation: 喔，嗨，@！#$e#你喜歡小孩嗎？$l

records.source: It's fall already?$s
records.translation: 已經秋天了？$s

records.source: It's gross when all these fallen leaves get slimy.
records.translation: 這些落葉變得黏糊糊時真噁心。

records.source: Hmm... Something smells weird...#$e#You've been working on the farm, huh?
records.translation: 嗯……有股怪味……#$e#你剛才在農場工作，對吧？

records.source: Oh, hi. Did you want something?
records.translation: 喔，嗨。你有事嗎？

records.source: I feel the urge to go shopping. *sigh*
records.translation: 我突然好想去逛街。*嘆氣*

records.source: Is that a grass stain on your knee?#$e#Sorry, I'm allergic to grass.
records.translation: 你膝蓋上的是草漬嗎？#$e#抱歉，我對草過敏。

records.source: It's too cold to go to the beach anymore.#$q 44 fall_Sat_old#*sigh*...what do you think I should do today?#$r 44 10 fall_Sat_12#Watercolor painting#$r 44 20 fall_Sat_12#Relax and read a magazine#$r 44 -30 fall_Sat_13#Stop being a selfish crybaby
records.translation: 天氣太冷，已經不能去海灘了。#$q 44 fall_Sat_old#*嘆氣*……你覺得我今天該做什麼？#$r 44 10 fall_Sat_12#畫水彩畫#$r 44 20 fall_Sat_12#放鬆地看雜誌#$r 44 -30 fall_Sat_13#別再當個自私的愛哭鬼

records.source: I'll probably take a nap later.
records.translation: 待會兒大概會睡個午覺。

records.source: Hmm... That's a pretty good idea, actually.
records.translation: 嗯……其實這個主意相當不錯。

records.source: Get away from me, you stupid jerk.$a
records.translation: 離我遠點，你這個笨蛋混球。$a

records.source: I've never been to the forest. It's muddy and I could get a blister on my foot.
records.translation: 我從沒去過森林。那裡滿是泥巴，還可能讓腳磨出水泡。

records.source: Something smells earthy...#$b#Oh, right. You work on a farm.
records.translation: 聞起來有股泥土味……#$b#喔，對喔。你在農場工作。

records.source: You look like you've been doing a lot of hard work.#$b#Why don't you take the rest of the day off?
records.translation: 你看起來做了很多辛苦的工作。#$b#今天剩下的時間何不休息一下？

records.source: If you're ever bored, come say hi.
records.translation: 如果覺得無聊，就來打個招呼。

records.source: Shopping just doesn't sound as fun as it used to.#$e#What's happening to me?#$e#Hmm...
records.translation: 購物聽起來不像以前那麼有趣了。#$e#我到底怎麼了？#$e#嗯……

records.source: $p 48#Did I ever tell you I found another one of my great-grandma's bracelets in the attic?|See this bracelet? It belonged to my great-grandmother.#$e#She was a really interesting lady.
records.translation: $p 48#我有告訴過你，在閣樓又找到曾祖母的一只手鐲嗎？|看到這只手鐲了嗎？它屬於我的曾祖母。#$e#她是位非常有意思的女士。

records.source: I've never been to the forest, you know.#$e#It might be interesting to explore it some day.
records.translation: 你知道嗎，我從沒去過森林。#$e#也許哪天去探索會很有趣。

records.source: I'm starting to like the smell of dirt. Isn't that weird?#$e#I think it's because you're around all the time.$h
records.translation: 我開始喜歡泥土的氣味了。是不是很奇怪？#$e#我想是因為你總在身邊。$h

records.source: @, I'm happy to see you today.$h
records.translation: @，今天見到你真開心。$h

records.source: I want to move somewhere warmer.
records.translation: 我想搬去更溫暖的地方。

records.source: Hi. Do you need something from me?#$e#...
records.translation: 嗨。你找我有事嗎？#$e#……

records.source: Hmm. What brand is your shirt?#$e#Oh. Um, never mind.
records.translation: 嗯。你的襯衫是什麼牌子？#$e#喔。呃，算了。

records.source: I wish someone would bring me a peppermint coffee.$s#$e#Don't even bother, I know you won't be able to make one.
records.translation: 真希望有人能帶一杯薄荷咖啡給我。$s#$e#不用費心了，我知道你做不出來。

records.source: I'm going to start writing a list of all the clothes I need for next spring.
records.translation: 我要開始列出明年春天需要的所有衣服。

records.source: Do you have a pony on your farm?$h#$e#Oh. That's disappointing...$s
records.translation: 你的農場有小馬嗎？$h#$e#喔。真令人失望……$s

records.source: The only good thing about winter is that I get to sleep more.#$e#I like at least 10 hours of sleep every night.
records.translation: 冬天唯一的好處就是能睡更久。#$e#我每晚至少要睡十個小時。

records.source: Will you say hi to Alex for me?#$e#Thanks.
records.translation: 能替我向亞歷克斯問好嗎？#$e#謝啦。

records.source: Your name is @, right?#$e#I keep forgetting.
records.translation: 你的名字是@，對吧？#$e#我老是忘記。

records.source: Hi @.#$e#Is anything exciting happening on your farm?
records.translation: 嗨，@。#$e#你的農場有發生什麼令人興奮的事嗎？

records.source: I think I'm starting to realize that clothes aren't the most important thing. Right?#$e#I still like clothes, though. I mean, what's wrong with expressing yourself a little?
records.translation: 我想自己開始明白，衣服並不是最重要的東西。對吧？#$e#不過我還是喜歡衣服。我的意思是，稍微表達自我有什麼錯？

records.source: Maybe I'll donate some of my skirts to a charity this spring.#$e#I mean, I do have over 1,000 skirts.$h#$e#...what?
records.translation: 也許今年春天會把一些裙子捐給慈善機構。#$e#我的裙子確實超過一千件。$h#$e#……怎樣？

records.source: Um, if you see Alex could you tell him I'm busy today?#$e#Thanks.
records.translation: 嗯，如果見到亞歷克斯，能告訴他我今天很忙嗎？#$e#謝啦。

records.source: I wish it were warmer here in Stardew Valley.#$e#I could move somewhere else, but...
records.translation: 真希望星露谷能更溫暖。#$e#我可以搬去別的地方，但是……

records.source: Do you think you'll ever have a pony on your farm?
records.translation: 你覺得自己的農場有一天會養小馬嗎？

records.source: I'm glad you have less work to do in the winter.#$e#It must be nice to have a break, huh?
records.translation: 很高興你冬天的工作比較少。#$e#能休息一下肯定很棒，對吧？

records.source: @, you look rugged today. I like it.^@, you look pretty today.#$e#...$h
records.translation: @，你今天看起來很有男子氣概。我喜歡。^@，你今天看起來很漂亮。#$e#……$h
